capabilities: preview the current note as a mind map
pin the mind map pane to a note while browsing others
copy the mind map as SVG to the clipboard
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a single note's heading/content hierarchy as a mind map.

relations.evidence: viewing Markdown notes as Mind Maps using Markmap
A similar plugin is available for Visual Studio Code.

summary: Renders the current Markdown note as an interactive mind map using Markmap, in a pane that follows the active note.
